Thanks for watching.


Ron Mann (@RonMann19)

No other evening news show does this level of in-depth and knowledgeable interview to the benefit of it’s viewers.



— https://nitter.net/RonMann19/status/2036960168194322760#m
Tonight I was joined by UAE Minister of State, Lana Nusseibeh and she warns Iran’s actions could impact the entire global economy #specialreport
Last night I took a look at the evolving military situation with Iran, focusing on regional threats and critical energy points  #specialreport #news
Thank you for all the questions have a great rest of your Tuesday and be sure to tune into #specialreport tomorrow #tiktoktuesday
Today is TikTok Tuesday, be sure to send in whatever questions you have and I’ll answer them on air tonight at 6PM ET on #specialreport
The Seattle Kraken will play their first-ever games outside North America, facing the Hurricans in Helsinki this November 🏒 #seattlekraken #seattletiktok #specialreport
New advances in AI are making geothermal energy more accessible and scalable as a steady domestic power source #energymatters #specialreport
Tonight I looked at fusion and how it’s grown as a power source and what that could mean for your future on #specialreport
Brit Hume shares hit thoughts on the conflict in Iran after the resignation of Joe Kent the former Director of the National Counterterrorism Center #specialreport

Lots happens behind the scenes, and I had a great time interviewing Senate Majority Leader John Thune. Be sure to catch my interview on @Fox News ! #Interview #Senate #JohnThune #Politics #BehindTheScenes
Here are some behind the scenes clips from my exclusive interview with Senate Majority Leader John Thune  #behindthescene #bts #interviews
